# Contact details

All facts live in `src/config/site.ts`.

| Fact | Status |
| --- | --- |
| WhatsApp number | **Set** in `whatsappNumber`. Any format works (spaces and `+` are stripped). |
| Phone, email, address, CR number | Placeholders (`[PHONE]` etc.), hidden from the UI until set. |
| Social links | Empty; icons only render when a URL is set. |

The client will send the remaining details after the design is approved.
